# Krita iPadOS bug report

Please use the
[iPadOS bug report form](https://github.com/serika12345/krita-ipad-port/issues/new?template=ipados_bug_report.yml)
so that the device, installation, reproduction, and diagnostic information is
included.

This repository tracks problems specific to the iPadOS port. Bugs that also
reproduce in an official desktop or Android build of Krita belong in the
[upstream Krita bug tracker](https://bugs.kde.org/).

Do not attach Apple IDs, certificates, provisioning profiles, device
credentials, or other signing secrets.
